Blue cheese, pear and honeyed walnuts.How to make it1 baguette, sliced thinly on an angle2 tbsp olive oil150g creamy blue cheese100g cream cheese2 ripe pears, thinly sliced60g walnuts2 tbsp honey2 thyme sprigsBrush the bread with oil and bake at 190°C until crisp.Toss the walnuts with half the honey in a hot pan until sticky, then cool.Beat the blue cheese with the cream cheese until spreadable.Spread on the toasts, top with pear and walnuts, drizzle with the remaining honey and scatter with thyme.Max's birthday party pigs in blanketsMax turns five. Dad never shows. Mini franks in puff pastry, honey mustard.How to make it24 cocktail frankfurts2 sheets of frozen puff pastry, thawed1 egg, beaten2 tsp sesame seeds3 tbsp Dijon mustard2 tbsp honey3 tbsp tomato sauceCut each pastry sheet into 12 strips.Roll a strip around each frankfurt, seam side down on a lined tray.Brush with egg, scatter with sesame and bake at 200°C until puffed and golden.Party bags for the kidsDad promised he'd be here.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.Main CourseMr. Allen's good roast lambMr. Allen loves a good roast. Garlic and rosemary lamb, crisp potatoes, mint salsa verde.How to make it2kg lamb leg, bone in4 garlic cloves, sliced4 rosemary sprigs3 tbsp olive oil1.2kg potatoes, cut in chunks1 cup mint leaves1 cup parsley leaves1 tbsp capers1 lemon100ml extra virgin olive oilCut small slits all over the lamb and push in garlic slices and rosemary sprigs, then rub with oil and salt.Roast at 180°C for about 1 hour 20 minutes for pink, then rest under foil.Parboil the potatoes, rough them up and roast in oil around the lamb for the last hour.Chop the mint, parsley and capers and stir in the lemon juice and olive oil.Carve the lamb and serve with the potatoes and salsa verde.DessertMax's birthday wish chocolate cakeMax wishes Dad can't lie for a day. Chocolate layer cake, fudge icing, candles.How to make it225g plain flour60g cocoa powder, plus 40g for the icing300g caster sugar2 tsp baking powder2 eggs250ml milk125ml vegetable oil250ml hot coffee or water150g soft butter300g icing sugar5 birthday candlesWhisk the flour, 60g cocoa, sugar and baking powder, then beat in the eggs, milk and oil, and finally the hot coffee.Divide between two lined 20cm tins and bake at 180°C until a skewer comes out clean.Beat the butter, icing sugar and 40g cocoa with a splash of milk until fluffy.Sandwich and cover the cooled cakes with the icing.Push in five candles, light them and make a wish.To ToastFletcher's truth serum24 hours of nothing but the truth. Gin, lemon, honey and soda, tall.How to make it240ml gin3 lemons4 tbsp honey4 tbsp warm water600ml soda water2 cups ice cubesStir the honey into the warm water to make a syrup.Shake the gin, lemon juice and syrup with ice and strain into 4 tall glasses of ice.Top with soda and a lemon slice.Sparkling grape juiceA year on, Max only wishes for rollerblades.How to make itA house standard, not part of tonight's cook.
